        <script><![CDATA[/**
 * Reorder Level Monitor — Async BR on Inventory Stock
 *
 * Creates a reorder_required inventory alert when available_quantity
 * reaches or falls below reorder_level. Purely INFORMATIONAL —
 * never blocks or aborts any stock update.
 *
 * Duplicate prevention: checks for existing OPEN alert where
 * inventory_stock = this stock AND alert_type = reorder_required.
 * Does NOT suppress reorder alerts because a below_safety_stock
 * alert exists — both types may coexist.
 *
 * Severity:
 *   medium — available <= reorder_level AND available > safety_stock
 *   high   — available <= reorder_level AND available <= safety_stock
 *
 * Uses ONLY inv_stock.reorder_level (not mat_master.reorder_level).
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var reorderLevel = parseFloat(current.getValue('reorder_level')) || 0;

    // If reorder_level is zero or not set, nothing to monitor
    if (reorderLevel <= 0) {
        return;
    }

    var availableQty = parseFloat(current.getValue('available_quantity')) || 0;

    // If available is above reorder level, no alert needed
    if (availableQty > reorderLevel) {
        return;
    }

    // --- available_quantity <= reorder_level ---

    // Check for existing OPEN reorder_required alert for this stock
    var stockSysId = current.getUniqueValue();
    var existingAlert = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_inv_alert');
    existingAlert.addQuery('inventory_stock', stockSysId);
    existingAlert.addQuery('alert_type', 'reorder_required');
    existingAlert.addQuery('status', 'open');
    existingAlert.setLimit(1);
    existingAlert.query();

    if (existingAlert.next()) {
        // An open reorder_required alert already exists for this stock.
        // Do not create a duplicate.
        return;
    }

    // Determine severity
    var safetyStock = parseFloat(current.getValue('safety_stock')) || 0;
    var severity;
    if (safetyStock > 0 && availableQty <= safetyStock) {
        severity = 'high';
    } else {
        severity = 'medium';
    }

    // Build alert message
    var materialRef = current.getDisplayValue('material_product');
    var locationRef = current.getDisplayValue('location');
    var alertMessage =
        'Reorder required: Available stock for ' + materialRef +
        ' at ' + locationRef +
        ' has reached ' + availableQty +
        ', which is at or below the reorder level of ' + reorderLevel + '.';
    if (severity === 'high') {
        alertMessage += ' Stock is also at or below the safety stock threshold (' + safetyStock + ').';
    }

    // Create the reorder_required alert
    var alert = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_inv_alert');
    alert.initialize();
    alert.setValue('alert_type', 'reorder_required');
    alert.setValue('severity', severity);
    alert.setValue('status', 'open');
    alert.setValue('alert_message', alertMessage);
    alert.setValue('alert_date', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
    alert.setValue('material_product', current.getValue('material_product'));
    alert.setValue('inventory_stock', stockSysId);
    alert.setValue('current_quantity', availableQty.toString());
    alert.setValue('threshold_quantity', reorderLevel.toString());
    alert.insert();

    gs.info(
        'Reorder alert created for stock [' + stockSysId + ']: ' +
        'available=' + availableQty + ', reorder_level=' + reorderLevel +
        ', severity=' + severity
    );
})(current, previous);
]]></script>
